claims.text: Saronic announced the groundbreaking of Port Alpha in a release datelined Brownsville, September 30th, 2026.
claims.quote: Saronic today announced the groundbreaking of Port Alpha, a next-generation American shipyard built to restore the nation's maritime industrial capacity.
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says Port Alpha sits on 835 acres at the Port of Brownsville.
claims.quote: Situated on 835 acres at the Port of Brownsville
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the site carries an option to expand to nearly 4,400 acres.
claims.quote: with the option to expand to nearly 4,400 acres
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic describes Port Alpha as a private capital investment of more than $3 billion.
claims.quote: represents a private capital investment of more than $3 billion
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the shipyard is expected to generate up to 10,000 direct jobs.
claims.quote: is expected to generate up to 10,000 direct jobs
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic calls Port Alpha a software-defined facility for autonomous, autonomy-capable and manned ships.
claims.quote: Saronic is building a clean-sheet, software-defined facility designed from the ground up to deliver autonomous, autonomy-capable, and manned ships at speed and scale
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says Port Alpha will open with an initial 150,000 gross tons of annual shipbuilding capacity.
claims.quote: Port Alpha will introduce an initial 150,000 gross tons of annual shipbuilding capacity
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says capacity could potentially scale to over 2 million gross tons.
claims.quote: with the potential to scale to over 2 million gross tons
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the yard will initially be able to build vessels up to 850 feet long.
claims.quote: Port Alpha will initially be capable of producing vessels up to 850 feet
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says future site expansion could support vessels over 1,200 feet long.
claims.quote: future site expansion could support production of vessels over 1,200
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says initial operations will include 1.2 million square feet of enclosed production space.
claims.quote: Port Alpha will encompass 1.2 million square feet of enclosed production space
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says that space will be spread across 8 to 10 production buildings.
claims.quote: spread across 8 to 10 dedicated production buildings
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the yard will be served by more than 2,500 feet of deepwater quay.
claims.quote: served by more than 2,500 feet of deepwater quay
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says two to four build positions will handle final ship erection.
claims.quote: Two to four build positions will handle final ship erection
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the first phase includes Landing Craft Utility vessels for the U.S. Navy.
claims.quote: This first phase will focus on building autonomous, autonomy-capable, and manned ships, including Landing Craft Utility (LCU) vessels for the U.S. Navy.
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says it selected the JE Dunn and Alberici joint venture to build the initial phase.
claims.quote: Saronic has selected JE Dunn | Alberici Joint Venture to construct this initial phase
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says it hosted Vice President JD Vance and Governor Greg Abbott at the groundbreaking.
claims.quote: Saronic was honored to host Vice President JD Vance and Governor Greg Abbott
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says it is working with the State of Texas, Cameron County and regional educational institutions on training and apprenticeship pathways.
claims.quote: Saronic is working with the State of Texas, Cameron County, and regional educational institutions on engineering pipelines, technical training, and apprenticeship pathways
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic chief executive Dino Mavrookas said Port Alpha was designed to make autonomous and manned vessels at scale.
claims.quote: Port Alpha is designed from the ground up to produce both autonomous and manned vessels at scale
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says the jobs range from welding and machining to robotics, software engineering and naval architecture.
claims.quote: from skilled trades such as welding and machining to advanced roles in robotics, software engineering, and naval architecture
claims.document: Saronic press release on PR Newswire, Saronic Breaks Ground on Port Alpha, a New Model for American Shipbuilding, September 30th, 2026

claims.text: Saronic says its Marauder has a top speed of 25+ knots, a range of up to 5,400 nautical miles and a payload capacity of 150 metric tons.
claims.quote: has a top speed of 25+ knots, a range of up to 5,400 nautical miles, and a modular payload capacity of 150 metric tons
claims.document: Saronic Technologies home page

claims.text: Saronic says on its home page that a Corsair rescue in the Strait of Hormuz was the first known at-sea rescue by an autonomous boat.
claims.quote: Rescue operation marked the first known at-sea rescue by an autonomous boat
claims.document: Saronic Technologies home page

claims.text: The Texas Tribune reported on June 18th, 2026 that the Cameron County Commissioners Court approved a $211 million tax break for Saronic Technologies.
claims.quote: The Cameron County commissioners court approved a $211 million tax break for Saronic Technologies
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Tribune reported that the court approved the tax break before Saronic had picked the Port of Brownsville, and described a $3.2 billion naval shipyard called Port Alpha.
claims.quote: in hopes that the company will select the Port of Brownsville for its $3.2 billion naval shipyard called Port Alpha
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Tribune reported that the tax break takes the form of a 95% abatement over 20 years.
claims.quote: The tax break would come in the form of a 95% tax abatement agreement over 20 years.
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: Under the agreement as the Tribune reported it, 35% of the full-time workforce must be local residents.
claims.quote: 35% of their full-time workforce is required to be local residents
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Tribune reported that the abatement shrinks if Saronic misses its job projections.
claims.quote: If Saronic falls short of job projections, the tax abatement would decrease.
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: More than two dozen people spoke to the county commissioners about the agreement, for and against, the Tribune reported.
claims.quote: prompted more than two dozen people to address the county commissioners during a meeting this week
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: Opponents told the court the abatement would take money from public schools, the Tribune reported.
claims.quote: Opponents also said the abatement would take away money from public schools.
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: Brownsville resident Victoria Oseguera asked why a billion dollar company should get a tax break in a small city.
claims.quote: Why is it fair that a billion dollar company comes to our small city and asks for a tax break?
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Tribune reported 1,200 engineering and design jobs, 700 in administration and support and 699 in research and development.
claims.quote: Another 1,200 positions would be in engineering and design, 700 in administration and support, and 699 in research and development.
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Greater Brownsville Economic Development Corporation is offering Saronic an additional $10 million incentive, the Tribune reported.
claims.quote: which is offering Saronic an additional $10 million incentive
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: In June Saronic told the Tribune in a statement that it had not yet selected a location for Port Alpha.
claims.quote: Saronic issued a statement confirming the company had not yet selected a location for Port Alpha.
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026

claims.text: The Tribune reported that Saronic had secured a $392 million U.S. Navy contract for autonomous maritime capabilities.
claims.quote: Saronic secured a $392 million contract from the U.S. Navy for autonomous maritime capabilities
claims.document: The Texas Tribune, Berenice Garcia, June 18th, 2026
